[[Kegai]] is a member of the [[Jade Brotherhood]] and would like nothing more than to see the [[Am Fah]] wiped from the face of [[Cantha]].  To that end, he stands on the docks in Wajjun Bazaar and offers rewards to interested parties for dispatching the Am Fah.

==Locations==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}}

==Dialogue==
:''"The Am Fah are murderous thieves of the lowest sort. Little more than pond scum, if you ask me. It is in the interest of my organization that these Am Fah disappear. If you are willing, I could make it worth your while. Dispatch some Am Fah and bring me 5 [[Plague Idol]]s as proof, and I will give you this:"''
